# Secret-scan allowlist. One entry per line:

#   path/to/file      silence every finding in the file
#   path/to/file:12   silence one line of the file

# Entries are repository-relative. Every entry needs a reason. The
# scanner prints `path:line` for each finding, so a drifted line number
# shows up as a new finding and this file must be updated.
